headline: Software and methods advance site-resolved and single-cell proteomics quantification
label: Proteomics Analysis Tools
summary: Proteomics methods now span single-cell, spatial and PTM-resolved scales, demanding reproducible, interoperable analysis software.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational infrastructure for proteomics: methods that resolve quantitative signal at finer granularity and package it for reuse. STRIDE aligns DIA-MS peptidoform peaks across runs using dynamic programming and ion-signature propagation, reducing false negatives relative to DIA-NN for site-localized PTM quantification at scale. A benchmark of normalization, imputation and clustering for mass-spectrometry single-cell proteomics of PBMCs accompanies a probabilistic classifier for protein-level immune lineage. The organelle atlas maps about 8,000 proteins across mouse, human and neonatal pig islets, with machine learning assigning insulin granule components. The spatialproteomics toolbox provides an interoperable Python framework for segmentation and cell typing in multiplexed immunofluorescence. Each contribution is specific to its data type rather than a shared algorithm.
